english_title: Summation Involving Fibonacci Numbers, Simple Version
statement_en:
Let \(F_n\) be the \(n\)-th Fibonacci number. Evaluate
$$\\sum_{n \\geq 1} \\frac{1}{F_nF_{n+2}}.$$
prerequisites: definition and basic properties of Fibonacci numbers
